npc.alexander.stdmod_1: [PT] Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alexander.stdmod_2: [PT] I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_1: [PT] Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_2: [PT] Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_3: [PT] Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_4: [PT] Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_5: [PT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_6: [PT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_7: [PT] If you need general {equipment}, just ask me for a {trade}. I can also provide you with some general {hints} about the game.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_8: [PT] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_9: [PT] I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_10: [PT] I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_11: [PT] My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: [PT] It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_13: [PT] If you want to challenge monsters in the {dungeons}, you need some {weapons} and {armor} from the local {merchants}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_14: [PT] If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_15: [PT] Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_16: [PT] The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_17: [PT] Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: [PT] One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_20: [PT] Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_21: [PT] Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_22: [PT] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_23: [PT] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_24: [PT] I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_25: [PT] Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_26: [PT] Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_27: [PT] Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_28: [PT] A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_29: [PT] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_30: [PT] The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_31: [PT] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_32: [PT] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_33: [PT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_34: [PT] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_35: [PT] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_36: [PT] No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_37: [PT] I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_38: [PT] Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_39: [PT] He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_40: [PT] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_41: [PT] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_43: [PT] Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_45: [PT] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_46: [PT] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_47: [PT] He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_48: [PT] If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_49: [PT] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_50: [PT] She's currently recovering from her travels in the {academy}. It's always nice to chat with her!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_51: [PT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_52: [PT] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_53: [PT] She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_54: [PT] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_55: [PT] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_56: [PT] She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_57: [PT] Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_58: [PT] Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_60: [PT] Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.
npc.alia.stdmod_1: [PT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.alia.stdmod_2: [PT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.alia.stdmod_4: [PT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.alia.stdmod_7: [PT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.alia.stdmod_9: [PT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.alia.stdmod_11: [PT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.alia.stdmod_12: [PT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_13: [PT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.alia.stdmod_14: [PT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_15: [PT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_16: [PT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_17: [PT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_18: [PT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_19: [PT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.alia.stdmod_20: [PT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_21: [PT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_22: [PT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_23: [PT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_24: [PT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: [PT] Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: [PT] We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: [PT] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: [PT] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: [PT] I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: [PT] It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
